title: Structural mechanism of mRNA decoding by mammalian GTPase GTPBP1
core_idea: Use cryo-electron microscopy of mammalian 80S ribosomal complexes bound to GTPBP1 and aminoacyl-tRNA with a non-hydrolysable GTP analog to define the molecular architecture and interactions underpinning GTPBP1's role in translation and quality-control pathways.
tldr: A structural study using cryo-EM aims to visualize GTPBP1 on mammalian ribosomes to clarify its molecular role in decoding and provide a framework for mapping disease-associated mutations.
